name: sashaslides-site
description: The sashaslides.com website: home, legal pages, walkthroughs, the developer page (/dev) and the self-hosted draw.io editor.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p dev/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p dev/tsconfig.pptx.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && tsx --test pages.test.ts site/logo-display.test.ts deploy/nginx-routing.test.ts dev/*.test.ts
